# openai_workspace_workload_identity_provider (Resource)

Beta. Manage a workload identity provider owned by a ChatGPT workspace for Codex. Requires a workspace admin personal access token with workspace.workload_identity.management. Shared tenant providers are managed with tenant resources.

Authentication: Set the workspace_admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_WORKSPACE_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the workspace API audience; with a custom workspace_base_url, set the workspace_admin_api_key provider attribute explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_workspace_workload_identity_provider" "example" {
  workspace_id              = "workspace_123"
  name                      = "ci"
  issuer                    = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
  attribute_transformations = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer` (String) issuer
- `name` (String) name
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the owning ChatGPT workspace.

### Optional

- `attribute_transformations` (Attributes List) Attribute expressions evaluated against the incoming identity. Removing the configuration clears the transformations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_transformations))
- `audience` (String) Expected audience claim for the external identity.
- `check_jti` (Boolean) check jti
- `custom_ca_certificate` (String) Public CA certificate for a supported remote verification method.
- `description` (String) description
- `enabled` (Boolean) enabled
- `max_assertion_lifetime_seconds` (Number) max assertion lifetime seconds
- `type` (String) Credential type. The API defaults to oidc.
- `verification` (Attributes) Verification settings. Defaults to OIDC discovery. Set type to discovery to clear uploaded keys or a JWKS URI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification))

### Read-Only

- `can_manage_provider` (Boolean) can manage provider
- `created_at` (Number) created at
- `id` (String) Workload identity provider ID.
- `owner_id` (String) owner id
- `owner_type` (String) owner type
- `updated_at` (Number) updated at
- `workload_identity_provider_id` (String) Workload identity provider ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openai_workspace_workload_identity_provider.example
  id = "workspace_123/id_123"
}
```
